shader_pattern_passage.name: The image leaves its frame
shader_pattern_passage.description: The carried circle repeats across a square, floor, walls, column, cube and an existing chair prefab. Nearby controls shift the pattern, change density and move the chair. Compare a room-anchored projection with one attached to the chair.
interactions: Grab or point-drag DENSITY / SHIFT / CHAIR
Press ATTACH to compare chair and room coordinates
shader_pattern_passage.qfep_connection: A shared surface can visually unite separate bodies; moving the receiver exposes whether the pattern belongs to the object or to the room.
